<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the protected alcohol (a TMS ether), gives back the alcohol precursor. The forward reaction breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl (O–H) and forms an O–Si bond. We'll search the template catalog for templates that break “aliphatic hydroxyls” in the forward direction. We'll use a representative protected molecule SMILES “CCO[Si](C)(C)C” (ethyl TMS ether) as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCO[Si](C)(C)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
